_note: TEACHES THE AGE LADDER. Won by reaching age 2, the Age of Embers, and by nothing else.
⚠️ THE 500 FOOD IS GUIDANCE, NOT AN OBJECTIVE (owner, 2026-09-02: *"500 food is not a
wining objective or tracked items, its purely user guidance"*). It briefly WAS a win
row here -- a `resource` subject added the same day -- and the owner withdrew it. It is
worth telling the player the number because 500 food is exactly what advancing costs
(ages.json), so the food counter climbing to 500 is the visible half of a goal that
otherwise shows nothing for several minutes. But it is the age that is tracked, and a
row the tracker (15.6) would tick off before the real objective started is a second
goal the player did not have.
THE `resource` SUBJECT STAYS IN THE VOCABULARY. It parses, evaluates and is tested
(ObjectiveDef.Subject.RESOURCE, ObjectiveSystem._stock_of); no shipped scenario uses it
today, and 16.6's Map Conditions screen is the obvious author of one. Removing it would
mean re-adding it later, and `subject` travels as an int -- so the enum position would
have to be got right a second time. Same shape as `area`/`named_unit`/`ticks`, which
this file's vocabulary has always declared ahead of use.
ONE ROW, AND IT NAMES NO id. `subject: age` counts nothing on the map -- it reads
SimPlayer.age -- so an id here would be meaningless and the loader refuses one rather
than ignoring it. THE VALUE IS THE AGE INDEX, NOT A COST: ages are indexed from 1, so
`>= 2` is 'has advanced once'.
STARTS AT AGE 1 for the obvious reason: a scenario about advancing an age cannot start
in the age it is asking you to reach. `starting_age` is one number for everybody, so
the passive opponent starts there too.
name: How To Age Up
description: A new age unlocks better buildings and better units. Gather enough to advance from the Age of Ash into the Age of Embers.
message:
Objective: Advance to the Age of Embers.

Overview: Select 3 of the villagers and have them gather food from berry bushes, have 1 villager gather wood from a tree, and have the last villager gather stone from a rock.

On the top right of the screen are your resource counters -- watch the food icon until it ticks up to 500, which is what advancing costs. Then tap the gold AGE icon at the top centre of your screen to age up. The ring around it shows how long the advance has left.
